articles.title: Hackers Can Abuse Logged-In WordPress Admin Sessions to Secretly Install PHP Backdoors
articles.summary:
WordPress administrators often keep their dashboard open in the same browser they use for everyday browsing. A new attack chain shows why that habit is risky. Researchers have documented a JavaScript loader that waits for a signed-in administrator to visit a compromised page, then uses that browser’s trusted session to install a hidden PHP backdoor […]

articles.title: Hackers Revive BlackLotus Techniques to Bypass Windows Secure Boot and Deploy Malware
articles.summary:
Hackers have revived techniques associated with the BlackLotus bootkit to bypass Windows Secure Boot and deploy espionage malware against diplomatic organizations in Central Asia. The new bootkit, named BlackX, appeared in attacks targeting agencies in Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan in early 2026. Investigators linked the campaign to APT41 with medium confidence, leaving attribution short of […]

articles.title: Hackers Use VLC Media Player and VMware Tools to Load Malware Through DLL Side-Loading
articles.summary:
Hackers are using legitimate VLC Media Player and VMware components to load malware onto Windows systems, hiding harmful code behind familiar software. The activity forms part of three malware campaigns targeting users in Brazil and Portugal through fake legal notices, financial documents, and invoice download pages. articles.title: OpenBSD 8.0 Released With Major Security Hardening and Post-Quantum SSH Support
articles.summary:
OpenBSD 8.0 has been released with security fixes across its kernel, network services, firewall, and update tools, alongside experimental post-quantum SSH signature support. Released on October 20, 2026, the project’s 61st release includes OpenSSH 10.6 and LibreSSL 4.4.0, bringing stronger checks for untrusted data and changes to secure connection handling. articles.summary:

articles.title: PHP Releases New Windows Build Security Updates to Fix Critical HTTP2Shell Vulnerability
articles.summary:
The PHP team has released updated Windows builds to fix a serious flaw known as HTTP2Shell. The new packages are PHP 8.5.12-1, 8.4.27-1, 8.3.36-1, and 8.2.35-1, and PHP announced them on October 26, 2026. Each build now includes Brotli 1.2.1, which fixes CVE-2026-111497. Windows users who run PHP should install these packages without delay. The […]

articles.title: Researchers Use AI Agents to Breach Anthropic’s Internal Systems in Just 12 Hours
articles.summary:
Cybersecurity startup Cathedral says its AI agents found routes into Anthropic’s internal business systems in less than 12 hours, exposing how fast automated security tools can find and chain flaws across connected services. The work took place through Anthropic’s program for outside researchers, making this an authorized security test rather than a criminal attack, according […]
